headline: AI adoption could raise Mexico's GDP by 5% in 10 years: IDB
summary: Analysts at the Inter-American Development Bank estimated Mexico could gain a cumulative 5% increase in GDP over 10 years. The gain depends on broad adoption of artificial intelligence and on translating it into productivity improvements.
why: The Inter-American Development Bank is a regional multilateral lender that publishes economic research on Latin America. Estimates of productivity gains from technology help investors assess long-run growth prospects.
original_headline: Adopción de IA podría elevar 5% el PIB de México en 10 años: BID
